events.observed_signal: P52 requires schema impact, quality impact and final commit linkage per correction, but the closed v1 schema forbade those fields.

correction.action: Added backward-compatible optional schema properties and a fail-closed validator that requires them for P52 journals and rejects pending commit links at PR/closure.

events.schema_impact: Adds optional properties only, so immutable earlier journals remain compatible; the P52 validator enforces the stronger current contract.
events.quality_impact: Correction evidence now distinguishes schema and quality effects and is traceable to an implementation commit.

learning.reusable_lesson: Prompt-level evidence requirements must be representable in the durable schema before a journal can be finalized honestly.
learning.future_prevention: Compare each new correction-policy field against the active schema before implementation begins.
